event.name: R008 Receive All Confirmed
event.condition: AND(ISNOTBLANK([Payment Request Token]), OR(ISBLANK([_THISROW_BEFORE].[Payment Request Token]), [Payment Request Token] <> [_THISROW_BEFORE].[Payment Request Token]))

branch: COUNT(SELECT(Loans[Row ID], [Ref Closing Payment] = CONCATENATE("r008:Borrowers|", LEN([_THISROW].[Row ID]), ":", [_THISROW].[Row ID], "|", [_THISROW].[Payment Request Token]))) > 0

tasks.body:
